units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:9:9">Y. Meg. I, 71ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>היה עשוי כמין ס׳</he> if the writing was done in the shape of arteries (furcated); cmp. <cite ref="H01039"><he>חֲלִיטָה</he> I</cite>.—

<cite ref="Chullin 49a:11">Ḥull. 49ᵃ</cite> (expl. <he>בית הסימפונות</he>, v. infra) <he>ס׳ גדול</he> the main branch (of the aorta); a. e.—Pl. <he>סִימְפּוֹנוֹת</he>, <cite ref="O00718"><he>סִמְ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:1">Ib. III, 1</cite> <he>עד שתינקב לבית הס׳</he> until the perforation of the lungs reaches the starting point of the ramified blood-vessels (v. supra), expl.
<cite ref="Chullin 45b:4">ib. 45ᵇ</cite> <he>להיכא דשפכי ס׳ כולהו</he> into which all the vessels discharge themselves.

senses.gloss: [cross-writing,] postscript to a document, codicil, conditions or modifications attached to a deed; receipt in full or in part.
units: Y. Gitt. VII, end, 49ᵃ; Y. Kidd. III, 64ᵃ top; Y. Erub. III, 21ᵇ top סדר ס׳ כך הוא וכ׳ this is the formula of a simpon (of betrothal), I—betroth thee—, with the condition that I marry thee on a certain day, and if that day arrives and I fail to marry thee, I shall have no claim &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 3:5:3">Ib.</cite> <he>ירדו לס׳ בשיטת וכ׳</he> they entered into a conditional agreement in accordance with the principle of R. M. &c. (i.e. stating both alternatives), v. <cite ref="V00719"><he>תְּנַאי</he></cite>. Y. B. Mets. X, 17ᶜ <he>ס׳ כתוב מלעיל וס׳ וכ׳</he> if one postscript is written at the top of the document, and one effaced at the bottom.

B. Mets. I, 8 (20ᵃ) אם יש עמהן ס׳ יעשה מה שבס׳ Y. ed. a. Ms. M. (Bab. a. Mish. ed. pl.) if a postscript is attached to the documents, you must be guided by the postscript. Ib. 20ᵇ ס׳ היוצא וכ׳ a postscript (receipt to a note) produced by the creditor. Ib. 21ᵃ ס׳ שיש עליו עדים a receipt signed by witnesses; a. fr.—Pl. as ab.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 1:8">B. Mets. I, 8</cite>, v. supra.

senses.gloss: an implicit condition the non-fulfillment of which annuls the agreement, whence, a bodily defect (of a woman or a slave) not stated in the contract.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 57b:16">Keth. 57ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>משום ס׳</he> because a bodily defect may be detected before marriage, which would annul the betrothal.
<cite ref="Ketubot 57b:16">Ib.</cite> <he>ס׳ בעבדים ליכא</he> a bodily defect detected in a slave does not affect the validity of the purchase.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 10b:14">Kidd. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>ולא חיישת לס׳</he> do you not take into consideration the possibility of finding a bodily defect by which the betrothal might be annulled?; a. fr.
